node.title: FACE-1 CORE (derivation candidate): jointness telescopes to the joint stabilizer
node.statement: Simultaneous K_M-stability across an active character set R is agreement with the JOINT stabilizer subcode — if the product over R telescopes into a single instance at the joint scale, Conjecture TR's jointness is STRUCTURAL (a tower statement, #212's machinery) rather than analytic, and the q^{M-1} per-leaf over-aggregation that M4 identified disappears by construction. E29's measurement then calibrates constants instead of deciding existence. Census: containment in all 519 cells (falsifier never fired); equality on all 343 full-class cells — the q^{M-1} over-aggregation vanishes BY CONSTRUCTION. E29 demotes to constants calibration.
